one_liner: Markets tumble as Nifty 50 drops 1.19% amid broad-based selling.

drivers.title: Broad Market Decline
drivers.detail: No specific catalysts identified for the decline.

drivers.title: IT Sector Gains
drivers.detail: IT was the only sector with gains.

drivers.title: FII Selling
drivers.detail: FIIs were net sellers in the cash market.

flows_line: FIIs sold Rs 2,977.86 Cr; DIIs bought Rs 2,686.05 Cr.
watch_next: Watch for GBP CPI and USD Federal Funds Rate announcements tomorrow.
lesson_seeds: Broad market declines can occur without specific catalysts.
IT sector can outperform even in a down market.
Volatility spikes often accompany market downturns.
Institutional flows can heavily influence market direction.
